## How the schemas map

| Aphrody SKILL.md | open-design `.od.yaml` |
|---|---|
| `name` | `name` (quoted scalar) |
| `description` | `description: \|` (block scalar) |
| `when_to_use` (double-quoted phrases) | `triggers:` list |
| _inferred from body_ | `od.mode` (`prototype` / `design-system` / `template`) |
| _inferred from name+description_ | `od.category` (slug) |
| `.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` | `od.source` (canonical pointer) |
